subject: Discovery recap + procurement handoff / next steps — FinServe
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finserve.com>
Date: 2026-06-25T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap + next steps — Redwood Inference

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciated the walkthrough of the FinServe fraud-detection use case. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- What we heard: you want a first-pass production endpoint for alerts enrichment and summarization, target latency < 300ms P95, and cost targets to keep token spend predictable for burst windows.
- Proposed trial: 4-week pilot on a dedicated instance, sample traffic + evening batch reranks.

Next steps:
1) Procurement/vendor setup: you mentioned your procurement team needs vendor onboarding, W-9, and ACH details. If you can share the procurement contact I will loop in our sales ops to start vendor registration.
2) Technical kickoff: schedule a 30-min handoff with our infra lead after vendor access is confirmed.
3) PO / timeline: you mentioned an early July go-live target — let me know if that window still works.

I am looping in Marissa from Sales Ops to lead the vendor onboarding (marissa.coled@redwood.ai) and Neha on contract logistics. I attached a short Redwood quickstart PDF that summarizes the deployment options.

Cheers,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182
Attachment: redwood_quickstart.pdf

Thanks for the recap — that matches our internal notes. Procurement will need standard vendor onboarding. Our primary procurement contact is Lisa Park (lisa.park@finserve.com). I'll cc procurement@finserve.com on this thread.
